title: More Information
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
More Information

Example: RTP Interface and Rate

Example: RTP Interface and Rate

The RTP interface HTNTMAX is used to determine the following billing values from a measured consumption profile (15-minute
interval):

e On-peak consumption
The total consumption in a period from 06:00:00 to 21:59:59 hours.
e Off-peak consumption
The total consumption in a period from 10:00:00 PM to 5:59:59 AM hours.

e Maximum demand value

Define the following result parameters in the RTP interface:

No.                            Description                 Function                     Operand Category
ool                            On-peak consumption | SUM                           QUANT

002                            Off-peak consumption | SUM                           QUANT

003                            Maximum demand         PEAK                          DEMAND

You allocate formula COPYQ1 to an RTP interface.

This formula has an input parameter with the profile value category quantity.

The formula has two output parameters: One output parameter is from profile value category quantity, to which the input
parameter values are copied. The other output parameter is from profile value category demand, in which the input parameter

values are converted into demand values.

In addition, the following RTP components are required:

Component                                       Description                                       Priority                                              Activation Type

ON/OFF                                     Calculation of On-Peak/Off-           1                                               Use and activate generally
Peak Consumption

MAX                                        Determine Max. Demand              2                                            Use and activate generally

(E)RTP Interface RTP1
GARTP Component ON/OFF

e RTP Component Code On-Peak Consumption
